notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid V0.1.5 now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[/list]

We will be soon back with more updates!

Thank you

notes.title: The Hidden Room - Pyramid V0.1.2 is now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Hidden Room - Pyramid V0.1.2 is now available with the following changes:

[b]Fixed an issue with documents not being visible after loading a savegame (sorry about this)[/b]
Please note: This fix only applies to new savegames. Old savegames that already have this issue (even if saved again) will still have the same issue.
Fixed an issue with shadows on the second floor that made them invisible
Fixed an issue with some interactable items being too large when examining them
Fixed an issue with a puzzle not working as designed
Various small map fixes

Thank you for playing!

Thank you for playing!
